chunks: 3 - Khalaf ibn Muhammad ibn Abi al-Hasan, al-Mawardi, al-Basri.
He was a ghālī in his madhhab. Weak. He is not regarded.

key_terms.ضَعِيفًا: Weak (in terms of hadith narrator reliability)
key_terms.مَذْهَبِهِ: His school of thought or sect

ai.seo_question: Who is Khalaf ibn Muhammad al-Mawardi and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book *Kitab al-Du'afa* (The Book of Weak Narrators). It describes Khalaf ibn Muhammad al-Mawardi as a 'ghali' (one who exaggerates in religious belief) and weak in hadith transmission, to the point that his narrations are not relied upon.

en.tashayyu: 3 – Khalaf b. Muḥammad b. Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māwardī, al-Baṣrī.
He was a ghālī in his madhhab.  Weak.  He is not regarded.
